title: Sequences, Statistics and Probability
summary: Grade 9: arithmetic and geometric progressions, grouped data and histograms, and probability with tree diagrams and experiments.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Recognising patterns in sequences and data lets us model change and make informed predictions about an uncertain future.

factual: What is the nth term of an AP?
How do you estimate the mean of grouped data?
conceptual: Why does experimental probability approach theoretical probability with more trials?
How is compound growth a geometric progression?
debatable: Can probability ever tell you what WILL happen?

cbseChapters: Class 9 Ganita Manjari (2026): Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions; The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability; Statistics
